interpretation.fusion: Two-sample export means of session medians improve 15.85 ms to 14.25 ms (1.112x), both candidates below both baselines; baseline bookend drift is 1.058x and Canvas control 1.012x. Higher-count improvements of 1.007x-1.037x overlap session variability. No general preview/frame-presentation gain is established. Count-one path is unchanged and provides a noisy control.
interpretation.remaining: Count-one path gives no established improvement and remains below native 2x Canvas/WebGL target on both profiles. Counts 2-64 of this exposure fixture exceed 2x on both profiles, but cannot close the broader native or 1.25x family acceptance. Original 117 cases remain individually tracked; strict WebGL family audits next.
interpretation.boundedPinned: Selected moving 400x300 solid on opaque 1920x1080: export mean session medians improve 2.676x-3.962x for counts 2-64 against fusion alone. Baseline drift <=3.1% for those counts and Canvas control changes -2.7% to +5.0%. RAF interval diagnostics improve 5.267x and 5.522x at 32/64 samples; low-count intervals remain about 8.3 ms. No GPU-completion or presentation guarantee.
interpretation.hardware: Both valid Apple M5 Pro brackets retained. Original two-sample candidate medians 6.4/2.9 ms; confirmation 2.8/3.3 ms. All-session baseline/candidate mean median ratio 0.987x there. Other-count changes are also comparable to variability; no broad hardware export or preview/presentation speedup is claimed. RAF interval diagnostics remain about 8.3 ms.

hardwareCombinedDescriptive.method: Two complete unchanged four-session brackets; every session retained, including original two-sample candidate outlier; no noise threshold introduced
